name: daily-workflow
description: Personal Work Logger (hooks that log work from parallel Claude Code sessions into a local Worklog), Morning (the day plan before the daily, its post-daily update and a home mode, from the Worklog, GitHub, Calendar, Jira, Slack, Gmail and Notion) and Inbox (capture Slack, PRs and email into the Notion GTD Inbox and process it one entry at a time on an HTML page).
